source_format_limitations: SUPERSEDED BY TFG-1 R2 (DEC:E3FMT-STRUCTURAL-SEPARATORS-PROXY-IDENTITY-AND-SOURCE-CONDITIONED-HOLDOUT): terminal cue phrases such as 'go ahead' and 'your line is now open' now carry ZERO admission authority. A structural separator is a question-bearing Operator/housekeeping handoff followed immediately by a non-housekeeping source turn, whether or not the questioner can be canonicalised.

Name is preserved when affiliation is missing or conflicting; affiliation_state is unresolved. Punctuated affiliations such as J.P. Morgan are kept exact or left unresolved, never truncated at the first period.

A verified questioner with a non-empty Analyst role stays question speech. A third-party non-management role (Analyst/guest/moderator/journalist/attendee/participant) that is not the verified questioner refuses rather than entering respondents.

Management is any remaining non-Operator/non-IR role after verified-questioner and non-management-role checks. Whole-segment spans only (start_byte=0, end_byte=utf-8 length). Intra-segment slicing is out of scope.
Topic labels remain unresolved; this receipt grants no topic or qa_exchange.v1 publication authority.

Questioner identity is direct (exact source-name equality), explicit full-name proxy (the differing next speaker's own first utterance binds them on-for/sitting-in-for the Operator-named principal; affiliation does not transfer), or unresolved -- a separator-only refusal that still splits windows so spans never merge across it.

Respondent role may come from a same-revision participant/title declaration when the answer segment is roleless, published as the frozen five-key extended respondent with replayable role_source_spans. Role comparison uses the closed CEO/CFO/COO alias table only; CIO is not an alias and conflicts refuse.
